#nullable enable
using System;
using Etl.Core.Abstractions;
using Etl.Core.Pipeline;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using LoadReferenceData.Csv;
using LoadReferenceData.Model;
using LoadReferenceData.Mapping;
using LoadReferenceData.TestDoubles;
using Xunit;

namespace LoadReferenceData.Tests;

public class DFT_LoadDepartmentStepDataFlowTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task DFT_LoadDepartment_WritesAtLeastOneRow_EndToEnd()
    {
        using var harness = new PackageHarness(useSampleDataForFileSources: true);
        var package = harness.Package();
        var uow = harness.NewUnitOfWork();

        var source = package.FF_SRC_Department();
        var transform = new DepartmentTransform();
        var sink = package.DepartmentDestination();
        var step = new DataFlowStep<DepartmentCsvRow, Department>("DFT_LoadDepartment", source, transform, sink, NullLogger<DataFlowStep<DepartmentCsvRow, Department>>.Instance);

        await step.RunAsync(uow, new LoadContext(Guid.NewGuid(), DateTime.UtcNow, "DFT_LoadDepartment"), CancellationToken.None);

        Assert.NotEmpty(uow.BulkInserts);
    }
}
